title: 8a.nu Send Grade Import Freshness Gap
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eighta:send
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by climber
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects athletes, devices, or exports that have stopped sending 8a.nu send grade data within the expected freshness window.
value: Stale performance data hides missed sessions and broken syncs, so a freshness alert protects the trend lines you rely on.
implementation: Review this at least daily and tune the freshness threshold to the normal cadence of the underlying app or export job.
visualization: Table of climber values by hours since the last 8a.nu send grade event.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds when data for 8a.nu send grade has stopped arriving and probably needs a sync check.
